# Muwafaq Sami — The Living Manuscript

> Portfolio of Muwafaq Sami, a creative writer, screenwriter, and narrative designer developing character-led fiction, dramatic scripts, and story worlds.

## About

Muwafaq Sami has worked in long-form ghostwriting, theatre scriptwriting, EPUB editing, short-form creative production, and social media content. The portfolio presents original writing and narrative concepts alongside selected documents.

## Core Specializations

- Creative writing and ghostwriting
- Screenwriting and dramatic development
- Narrative design, worldbuilding, and lore documentation
- Editorial work and digital publishing

## Selected Projects

- [The Fate of Moramania](https://portofolio-muwafaq.vercel.app/?project=the-fate-of-moramania#projects): Epic fantasy worldbuilding supported by a reference glossary.
- [Earth & Purgatory](https://portofolio-muwafaq.vercel.app/?project=earth-and-purgatory#projects): Dark supernatural fantasy concept about identity, power, and moral compromise.
- [Wild Horses](https://portofolio-muwafaq.vercel.app/?project=wild-horses#projects): Coming-of-age literary concept using retrospective conversation and uncertain memory.
- [What Remains of Us](https://portofolio-muwafaq.vercel.app/?project=what-remains-of-us#projects): Journal-format dark romance concept with restricted perspective.
- [The Monster in the Woods](https://portofolio-muwafaq.vercel.app/?project=the-monster-in-the-woods#projects): Psychological horror and mystery premise built around limited perspective.

## Notes

Project descriptions are spoiler-free summaries. Original concepts are not claimed as published or produced works. The PDF and Markdown resume are public documents supplied for this portfolio.
